d: Manage day-to-day operation of the delivery-programs cluster's cross-program cadence machinery for the Director - Delivery Programs. Implement the cluster-cadence routines and cluster-wide escalation pathways set by the Director. Drive reliable cluster-cadence discipline across multiple delivery programs. The Senior Manager Delivery Programs proactively leads the project delivery of a part of a larger Master planned entertainment-focused development Program in Dammam and ensures the successful development, construction and handover of a new 4-star Hotel project, including public realm, associated infrastructure works, and a marina. The Senior Manager Delivery Programs acts as the focal point for all project related matters representing SEVEN in terms of coordination and communication with all relevant internal and external stakeholders, team members, and project Consultants, Vendors, and Contractors involved in the development and delivery of the Dammam Hotel Project.
q: Minimum: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical), Construction Management, Architecture, or related discipline; Master's Degree preferred
Preferred Field: Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Project Controls or related discipline
PMP (Project Management Professional) or equivalent project management certification (preferred)
Program Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent program management certification (preferred)
FIDIC Contract Management or equivalent FIDIC-discipline certification (preferred)
Minimum Years of Relevant Experience: 12 years

Industry Experience (Preferred): Experience operationalizing program-cluster cadence across multiple large-scale hospitality and/or entertainment projects including cross-program reporting consolidation, FIDIC-cadence harmonization, schedule-budget-quality consolidation, value-engineering and lessons-learned cycles, and testing-commissioning-handover consolidation on giga-project, real estate development, hospitality and/or entertainment destination, or infrastructure delivery clusters
r: Manage day-to-day operation of the delivery programs cluster's cross-program cadence machinery to translate the Director - Delivery Programs' direction into reliable cluster-cadence execution across multiple delivery programs.

Implement the cluster-cadence routines, cross-program reporting protocols, and cluster-wide escalation pathways set by the Director - Delivery Programs to embed consistent cluster-cadence discipline at the execution layer.

Develop cluster-cadence tooling and cross-program reporting dashboards for cluster-wide KPI consolidation and lessons-learned capture across the delivery programs cluster to feed the Director - Delivery Programs' standardization cycles.

Analyse cross-program schedule-cost-quality variance trends, FIDIC-cadence performance, and cluster-wide risk-aggregation data across the delivery-programs cluster to surface evaluation inputs to the Director - Delivery Programs for cluster-wide intervention decisions.

Coordinate the cluster-cadence interface across the PMO, Technical Office, PMC and Lead Design Consultant counterparts, and internal and external Operations handover partners to secure cross-program harmonization and aligned cluster-cadence execution.

Enforce cluster-cadence standards, cluster-wide FIDIC-cadence discipline, and cross-program reporting cadence discipline across the delivery-programs cluster to protect SEVEN from cross-program harmonization and contract risk at the execution layer.

Monitor cluster-wide schedule-cost-quality variance and cross-program FIDIC-cadence breaches across the delivery-programs cluster and escalate material cluster-wide exposures and cross-program harmonization breaches to the Director - Delivery Programs.
Pro-actively manage Change and comply with all internal governance and reporting, by utilizing available PMC and CMC resources.

Establish an effective Project organization and day-to-day communication between all internal and external stakeholders involved, by utilizing and maximizing available internal resources, PMC and Lead Design Consultants' execution layer..

Pro-actively manage Risk, by continuously identifying, tracking and assessing potential impact and mitigation measures required throughout the Project life cycle, and establishing an effective Early Warning process and reporting by utilizing available PMC resources.
Monitor project schedule, cost, and quality performance against approved baselines, and report forecasts, variances, and recovery actions to the Director - Delivery Programs.

Ensure PMC and contractor compliance with QHSES standards, and lead testing, commissioning, and handover readiness with Operations and the hotel operator, to deliver a safe, operationally ready project.
Strategy: Lead delivery programs team priorities, standards, and improvement actions that support functional delivery plans.
Stakeholders: Coordinate stakeholders, consultants, contractors, and partners to resolve priorities, risks, and dependencies affecting delivery programs outcomes.
Budget: Track delivery programs budgets, resourcing, and consultant capacity to deliver assigned outcomes within control limits.
Governance: Maintain policies, standards, reporting routines, and risk controls to support compliant, auditable delivery programs controls.
People: Coach team capability, workload discipline, and accountable ways of working to sustain reliable delivery programs performance.

d: Lead the end-to-end handover process for District ICT Infrastructure services moving from delivery into live operations. The role ensures operational onboarding, documentation, support contracts, and knowledge transfer are completed to the required standard before service commencement.
q: Designing handover governance and applying it consistently across systems, vendors and projects
Service transition and operational onboarding expertise
Planning knowledge transfer and developing operational competency
Commercial awareness of support contracts, warranties and third-party obligations
Clear risk reporting, decisive escalation and confident chairing of reviews
Proven experience across core ICT infrastructure domains, including compute, storage, backup, networking and structured cabling
10+ years in IT or OT operations, including 4+ years in service or relationship management.
Sound understanding of IT/OT network segmentation, connectivity and cybersecurity principles.
Strong grasp of ITIL 4 incident, change and escalation management practices.
Experience working with OLAs, escalation matrices and governance in multi-party environments.
ITIL 4, CCNP or equivalent required; a cybersecurity awareness certification (e.g. CompTIA Security+) desirable.
r: Define and manage the handover governance framework for District ICT systems entering live operations.
Establish required handover deliverables, review checkpoints, sign-off criteria, and escalation principles.
Ensure handover governance is applied consistently across different District ICT Systems, vendors, and projects.
Maintain control over readiness status, approval pathways, and acceptance conditions.
Oversee onboarding of services into ICC, ServiceNow, and related operational support processes.
Ensure support workflows, service structures, escalation paths, and operational contacts are established before go-live.
Confirm that service records, operational inventories, support dependencies, and relevant tool configurations are complete and usable.
Verify that the receiving operations environment is prepared to support the new or changed service from day one.
Ensure delivery teams provide complete documentation packs, SOPs, operating procedures, support guides, and technical records.
Lead the planning and execution of knowledge transfer to BAU teams, including operational training and competency development.
Confirm that operational teams understand the service, support model, known risks, and recovery procedures ahead of service commencement.
Ensure training gaps and documentation issues are identified early and addressed before handover sign-off.
Ensure Data Inputs into ITAM & CMDB
Oversee support contract registration, warranty coverage transition, and support responsibilities for externally supported components.
Ensure contractual support obligations are reflected in the live support model and understood by operational teams.
Confirm third-party support contacts, service windows, and escalation commitments are documented and activated.
Track commercial dependencies that could affect service support after go-live.
Maintain a consolidated view of handover readiness, open risks, unresolved actions, and acceptance blockers.
Chair handover reviews and provide management with clear recommendations on transition readiness.
Escalate incomplete deliverables, support model gaps, or residual risks that may compromise stable BAU operation.
Drive closure of post-handover stabilization issues where formal follow-up is required.
Delivery teams and system integrators: Handover deliverables, documentation and open actions
ICC and BAU operations teams: Onboarding, training and day-one support readiness
ServiceNow, ITAM and CMDB owners: Service records, asset data and tool configuration
Vendors, OEMs and third-party support providers: Contracts, warranties and escalation commitments
Procurement and contracts teams: Support obligations and commercial dependencies
Senior management: Readiness recommendations, risks and escalations
